title: viola canina subsp. schultzii
intro: Viola canina subsp. schultzii, commonly known as European Pansy, is a flowering plant species belonging to the violet family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its use as a natural remedy for digestive issues and its potential anti-inflammatory properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Viola canina subsp. schultzii include flavonoids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Furthermore, the plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, and its therapeutic actions are thought to be due to its ability to reduce inflammation and promote relaxation.
